strategy.line: A rebrand is not a fresh coat of paint.
strategy.note: Done right it keeps the equity you have earned and sheds what is holding you back — so you look like the company you are now, not the one you were at launch. Sometimes it takes a new name. See how we build identity →

proof.note: Rebranding wakes the companies the world stopped seeing. Look at how a full system comes together.

faq.q: What does a rebranding agency do?
faq.a: A rebranding agency updates a company's strategy, positioning and identity so the brand matches what the business has become — then rolls it out everywhere without breaking what already works. We do all of it, strategy-first.

When you have outgrown the name or look you launched with, when you blend into competitors you used to lead, after a merger, pivot or new audience, or when the brand is holding back your pricing and your sales.

faq.q: Will I lose my brand equity or recognition?
faq.a: Not if it is done well. A good rebrand keeps the equity worth keeping and sheds only what is holding you back. We decide deliberately what carries forward, so you evolve rather than start over.

faq.q: How long does a rebrand take?
faq.a: A full strategy-led rebrand runs a few weeks to a couple of months, depending on scope and how many surfaces need to change. You get a real plan and date before we start.
It depends on scope — a refresh is not the same as a ground-up rebuild. Our brand work starts at $280; rebrands are quoted to what needs to change. See the full pricing.

closing.note: Tell us where the brand is now and where it needs to be. We will get you there without losing what you have built.
